summary: Cypht is an open-source webmail client and feed reader written in PHP. It aggregates multiple email accounts and web feeds into a single interface under the LGPL-2.1 licence.
goodFor: It is well-suited for users who want to consolidate their email checking and feed reading into one self-hosted web application.
watchOut: It faces strong competition from widely adopted, feature-rich webmail suites and alternative feed aggregators, which may offer more polished user experiences.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, deployment typically requires a standard web server like Nginx or Apache, alongside a PHP runtime and a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
